issues.on_page: Statement of Activities business-type column: Taxes - Levied for general purposes 40,336 and Intergovernmental 511,894
issues.issue: The proprietary statement (p6) puts Rescue Squad's 40,336 inside Intergovernmental 511,894, but the Statement of Activities (p2) prints 40,336 as business-type taxes. Recorded as printed on p6, but part of the line may be tax money.
'Public Building' would normally be general government. health/welfare is defensible only because p13 prints the amount in the General Fund's Cemetery column.
Same judgment call as disbursements[5]: Public Building treated as cemetery (health/welfare).

This is the Keno Fund's only real revenue, and net position prints 'Restricted: Keno', so it is very likely keno proceeds (keno/lottery). The label says only Miscellaneous, so other is defensible under the fund-name rule.
Mixed line: it includes the ARPA federal grant 115,573 (p12), about 35%. The dominant part is intergovernmental, and the line already has a review note.
